title: Knafeh with Cheese and Eastern Spices
description: A unique twist on the classic Middle Eastern dessert, this knafeh recipe combines nutty flavors with creamy cheese and eastern spices.

ingredients.name: Nutty pastry dough
ingredients.notes: such as phyllo or baklava dough

instructions: Unroll the nutty pastry dough and cut it into small squares.
In a bowl, mix together the knafeh cheese, middle eastern spices, and sugar.
Place a square of pastry dough in the bottom of a baking dish.
Spread a layer of the cheese mixture on top of the pastry.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of pastry on top.
Dot the top of the pastry with ghee or unsalted butter.
Bake the knafeh for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle with rose water, if using.
